title: [Engine] Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: layer split across 2 GPUs (single GPU = 58 tok/s vs 95 with llama.cpp -sm layer)
primaryEvidence: Issue body says Strata qwen36 uses GPU0 only, leaves GPU1 idle, and requests layer split in src/qwen35/q36_engine.cu.
testDecision: Blocked. Do not substitute a single-GPU run for the requested dual-RTX-3090 test.
reopenWhen: A released or pinned upstream commit implements and verifies layer split for qwen36, and an exact local quant is available.
